title: Bound on queried coordinates
statement: Let $n,r$ be natural numbers, and let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester for Boolean strings of length $n$ that makes $r$ query slots. For every seed of $T$, the number of distinct string coordinates queried is at most $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester for Boolean strings of length $n$ with $r$ query slots
